_readme: Autowriter queue. Items run top to bottom; status 'todo' is picked, then set to 'done' by the workflow. type 'product' needs an existing key in src/_data/products.js (affiliate link lives there). type 'guide' is a helpful how-to; 'product' on a guide is optional and must also exist in products.js. Never add a product without João's own affiliate link. 'pending' items are skipped until someone adds the product to products.js (with producer images) and flips status to 'todo'.
